title: Rito Ra Ku Tiyisela
intro: Munhu loyi u tsundzukiwa hi vutlhari lebyikulu ni nkongomiso, a nyikela ndzayo leyi tlulaka tinxaka. Marito ya vona i vumbhoni bya ku chava Xikwembu na nkoka wo lemuka mikateko na miringo leyi humaka eka Vukwembu. Pfuxeta vumunhu bya moya-xiviri lowu lowu xiximiwaka.
clues: A ndzi nga ri muprofeta, kambe vutlhari bya mina byi nga fi eka Matsalwa ya Vukwembu.
Xitsundzuxo xa mina eka n’wana wa mina a xi kandziyisa ku nkhensa Allah ni ku papalata ku shirk.
Ndzi dyondzise hi nkoka wa xikhongelo, ku lerisa leswinene ni ku yirisa leswo biha.
Ndzi tsundzuxe hi ku tikukumuxa ni ku famba hi ku tikukumuxa emisaveni.
Vito ra mina ri nyikiwile ndzima hinkwayo ya Quran, ri kandziyisa tidyondzo ta mina.
Xitsundzuxo xa mina a xi katsa ku lehisa mbilu eka maxangu, hikuva hakunene, sweswo swi huma eka timhaka leti tiyimiseleke swinene.

trial.label: Dyondzo/Nkongomiso wa Nkoka
options: Ku langutana ni vuthu ra matimba
Ku nyika vutlhari ni switsundzuxo swa mahanyelo
Ku rhangela rixaka ku ya eku hluleni
trial.answer: Ku nyika vutlhari ni switsundzuxo swa mahanyelo

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Vutlhari bya yena byi tsariwile eka Quran
U rhangele vanhu va yena etikweni lerintshwa
outcome.answer: Vutlhari bya yena byi tsariwile eka Quran

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
